data.title: Arbitrary integer cell size (1-64) + scale up UI to waste less space

data.body: Implemented both plan changes in commit 6595d63. (1) doc.ts: CELL_SIZES dropped for MIN_CELL=1/MAX_CELL=64/clampCell(round+clamp); main.ts stepCell now delta-based via setCell(clampCell), new onCellSet handler; toolbar.ts stepper steps +-1, shift-click +-8, readout is a button that swaps to a numeric input on click (Enter/blur commit clamped, garbage reverts, Esc cancels; aria-labels 'smaller cells'/'larger cells'/'cell size in pixels'). persist.ts needed no change — it already range-checks MIN/MAX (constants now 1..64). (2) app.css: device 1180->1400px, bezel height clamp(560px, 100dvh-300px, 920px) with 100vh fallback (880px media block keeps 320px), output column 372->440px; verified grid-editor's ResizeObserver on the bezel handles viewport-height reflow, no logic change. Verified: npx tsc --noEmit clean, npm run build clean, plus a node harness over the pure modules (scratchpad) — 27 checks: clampCell edges, size-13 draw both modes incl. locked center + torus wrap, undo across 13->27 resize restores dims+pixels, persist round-trip at 13, decode rejects 0/65 accepts 1, css export slice 13. Deviations: none from plan intent; note stepper CSS readout width fixed at 42px so button/input swap keeps layout, and only PM-6's lattice files were committed (shared _lifecycle.jsonl/ids.json + other tasks' files left for their owners per worktree discipline).

Cold review of 6595d63 against plan. Verified: (1) CELL_SIZES fully gone — grep finds only MIN_CELL=1/MAX_CELL=64/clampCell; no power-of-two or old-list assumptions anywhere (raster bit-shifts are RGBA packing, unrelated). (2) persist.ts already range-checks via MIN/MAX + Number.isInteger; harness confirms accepts 1/13/64, rejects 0/65/13.5/string; size-13 doc round-trips with correct buffer dims (39/13). (3) Click-to-edit readout: garbage and empty input revert (parseInt NaN guard), Esc cancels with stopPropagation (also shielded by main.ts INPUT-target early return so digits/hotkeys don't leak), Enter/blur double-commit prevented by the done flag with close() ordered before onCellSet so the readout is back in the DOM when sync() runs, Enter/Esc refocus the readout button. (4) Shift-click steps +-8 through the same clampCell path (60+8->64; at-limit tip preserved). (5) Undo unchanged: setCell still pushBoth-then-setCellSize, identical to old stepCell. (6) CSS valid: dvh clamp with vh fallback first; 880px media .bezel 320px still wins (later rule, equal specificity); box-sizing:border-box + shared .readout font rule keep button/input at identical 42px metrics. (7) Footprint independent of cell size — cellSize only feeds canvas math inside the fixed bezel (z=max(1,floor(min/Lf)) safe at cellSize=1). tsc --noEmit and vite build both clean. Minor nit, not a defect: blurring the input with an unchanged value emits the 'cell NNN already' tip. Verdict: PASS — meets all acceptance criteria, no rework needed.
